title: Canonical normalized étale Hom shift core data
statement: For a scheme X, a commutative-ring map A→B and a derived A-module M, there are normalized Hom CommShift structures and canonical composite CommShift structures whose right component equation and triangulated properties hold. The left component equation is omitted.

proof.text: Choose K-injective models for M and its scalar extension and flat-term K-flat source models. The signed Hom reindexing gives the normalized evaluation equations; scalar extension and the Hom adjunction give the right composite equation; the cone calculation gives the reversed triangulated structures.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08JC and 08J9: signed Hom shifts, scalar composition and contravariant exactness
